docTitle: Mamta Singh Sengar — ForwardEye Automation Test Engineer
name: MAMTA SINGH SENGAR
title: ==AUTOMATION TEST ENGINEER==  ·  AUTOMATED TEST DESIGN & COVERAGE

sections.heading: SUMMARY
sections.body: Automation test engineer with **2 years of automation experience**. Designed and implemented **automated test cases** with Playwright, Selenium BDD, and Rest Assured, and **improved test coverage** from 100 manual scenarios to automated checks across UI and API layers. Integrated suites into CI/CD, cutting release verification time from 3 days → 1 day.
